shared_rules.result_claim_ceiling: scenario coverage and structural readiness do not establish product superiority, food safety, service life, or regulatory conformity
cross_project_reuse: Symtropy thermal storage and dynamic integration: https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/symtropy/issues/1916

scenarios.purpose: Reproduce a declared standard or label-style energy profile and provide a matched commercial reference.
hard_gates: procedure identity and deviations are declared
temperature control requirements are met
instrument and calibration provenance are available
adversarial_controls: compare candidates tested under different procedures
report gross volume as usable volume
omit defrost or auxiliary loads
scenarios.claim_limit: Does not establish field energy use, food safety, or superiority outside this declared procedure.

scenarios.purpose: Assess whether temperature control and energy behavior remain acceptable across a market-relevant hot-ambient range.
hard_gates: temperature acceptance boundary is predefined for the intended use
all ambient levels are reported separately
adversarial_controls: extrapolate one ambient point to the entire climate class
omit a failed hot-ambient run
pool ambient profiles to hide a failure
scenarios.claim_limit: Only supports the ambient conditions actually tested.

scenarios.purpose: Measure temperature disturbance and recovery under repeated, repeatable door-opening events.
hard_gates: event log and temperature samples are time-aligned
missing event/temperature data remain explicit
adversarial_controls: use average temperature to hide a local excursion
use different door schedules between candidates
scenarios.claim_limit: Does not prove food safety or ordinary-household outcomes beyond the exact tested pattern.

scenarios.purpose: Compare cooling response after an explicitly defined warm load enters the cabinet.
hard_gates: load properties and endpoint are matched
air and product-simulant temperatures are reported as different measurands
adversarial_controls: claim a cabinet-air measurement is food-core temperature
change load mass or starting temperature
scenarios.claim_limit: A temperature trajectory alone is not microbiological or food-safety qualification.

scenarios.purpose: Measure outage holdover and recovery under exact declared initial conditions.
hard_gates: outage duration and all ambient/load assumptions are recorded
the pass threshold is selected by a competent, use-specific authority before testing
adversarial_controls: compare a fully loaded freezer with a minimally loaded reference
claim universal outage hours from a single run
allow temperature/door data gaps
scenarios.claim_limit: Applies only to the measured initial state, ambient and outage profile; not a universal holdover promise.

scenarios.purpose: Compare a declared PCM/thermal-buffer variant with its matched no-buffer baseline.
hard_gates: buffer identity and containment design are documented
energy and resilience results are separate
leakage/material hazards are separately reviewed
adversarial_controls: transfer a published saving percentage without matched reproduction
ignore usable-volume penalty
assume PCM benefits every compressor/control architecture
scenarios.claim_limit: PCM is a candidate only; the catalogue asserts no efficiency or resilience gain.

scenarios.purpose: Verify common non-refrigerant component repair and post-repair capability restoration.
hard_gates: hazard boundary and required technician qualification are observed
repair outcome is determined by post-repair checks, not task status
adversarial_controls: count incomplete repair as successful
substitute a part without compatibility evidence
include sealed-loop or live-mains DIY procedures
scenarios.claim_limit: Structural service evidence is not a refrigerant safety qualification or universal repairability claim.

scenarios.purpose: Assess an appropriate sealed bulk container for a declared lot of correctly conditioned dry staples.
hard_gates: starting food condition is qualified for the intended storage protocol
pest/contamination testing is contained and safely managed
food-contact suitability evidence is separate
adversarial_controls: use a damp starting batch and credit container airtightness
treat absence of visible insects as mycotoxin evidence
omit failed seals or damaged units
scenarios.claim_limit: Does not establish mold/mycotoxin safety, universal shelf life, or applicability to all foods.

scenarios.purpose: Compare a powder/flour vessel under repeated dispensing and resealing.
hard_gates: every cleaning and closure event follows the frozen method
missing product or spill mass remains accounted for
adversarial_controls: ignore residue traps
report total container capacity as accessible usable capacity
substitute unmeasured moisture values
scenarios.claim_limit: Does not support generalized claims for coffee, spices, produce, grains or other unrelated food classes.

scenarios.purpose: Compare a ventilated produce-storage module for one predeclared produce class; prevent inappropriate reuse of hermetic-staple logic.
hard_gates: test class and endpoint are produce-specific
ventilation is measured or declared with method
unobserved pathogen quality is not inferred
adversarial_controls: apply a staple-grain protocol to all produce
claim microbial safety from appearance
change produce maturity across candidates
scenarios.claim_limit: Supports only the declared produce class and conditions; not a universal freshness or safety claim.

scenarios.purpose: Evaluate whether gaskets, lids and latches can be maintained or replaced without compromising cleanability and closure function.
hard_gates: food-contact material and cleaning instructions remain applicable after repair
post-repair performance is measured
adversarial_controls: infer cleanliness from a smooth-looking surface
count part replacement without postcheck
ignore unavailable or destructive-to-replace seals
scenarios.claim_limit: Does not by itself establish food-contact compliance, product safety or service-life duration.
